name: Vampire Twilight Romance
source:
You’ve been told your whole life to avoid the dark, but there’s something about the shadowy unknown that’s always peaked your interest. That interest is what led you to serve a task force dedicated to keeping the streets safe for humans and night dwelling creatures at bay. Your job is not without dangers and you soon find yourself face to face with the most fearsome werewolf of them all who marks you with a dangerous curse that flips your world upside down.

Your overprotective captain decides it would be best to join forces with the other half of the team – the night dwellers who have allied with humans. Amongst them are vampires and demons who all seem to look at you with hungry eyes. It’s not often they see a human willing to risk their life on the front lines of darkness. Will you stand strong under the hungry gazes of vampires and werewolves, or will you crumble and let them devour you?

[From [url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.genius.newtwilight]Google Play[/url]]
translation:
你一生都被告知要避开黑暗，但有一些关于阴暗的未知事物总是能激发你的兴趣。这种兴趣促使你加入了一个工作组，致力于保护街道上的人类和夜栖生物的安全。你的工作并非没有危险，你很快就会发现自己面对的是最可怕的狼人，他们给你施加了危险的诅咒，让你的世界发生了翻天覆地的变化。

你过度保护的队长决定最好与团队的另一半——与人类结盟的夜栖者——联手。其中有吸血鬼和恶魔，他们似乎都用饥饿的眼睛看着你。他们很少见到愿意冒着生命危险走在黑暗前线的人。你会在吸血鬼和狼人饥饿的目光下坚强地站立，还是会崩溃并让他们吞噬你？

[来自[url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.genius.newtwilight]Google Play[/url]]
